-- TTEX Talk Scene File: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
-- Quest #65 / Scene #1 - Function alsmeer_rotrua
function alsmeer_rotrua()
	SetTransitionType(2)
	HideOriginalObjs(1)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("town002D.map")
	MoveCamera(818.00, 1106.00, 52.34)
	RotCamera(6.26, 1.57, 12.00)

	CreateObject(0, 10012, 818.00, 1106.00, 0, 0, FALSE, 0, 0)

	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()

	OpenTalkScene(10, 1)

	RevPhase4()
	RevPhase3()
	RevPhase2()

	Q.DeleteAllObject()
	RestoreMap()

	RevPhase1()
end

Register(alsmeer_rotrua)
